timer: the runtime's D3D12 timestamps in the game's command list (timing_log=1, timing_stages=1): each sample is one 'timing, last 300 dispatches' line = the mean over 300 frames; stage spans [0] start of the network -> [1] first Swin kernel -> [2] dec0 -> [3] post -> [4] after the last kernel; network_total = [0]->[4]; TOTAL_t3_t0 = the frame's full D3D12 span
statistics: over the 300-frame windows of each scene: median, p95, min of the window means; max_ms = the largest window mean; the largest single frame per window is in the log (max ...) and given as worst_frame_network_ms / worst_frame_total_ms
what: Model L with its default post (since #170: its own reconstruction l_post_recon_p12 + filter), Model L with l_post=m (Model M's fused pack12 post) and Model M as a control, in Cyberpunk 2077, one session, one build, the same settings, save and spot
